options.name: action
options.description: Specifies which operation to perform on logical volumes. C(encrypt) enables encryption and encrypts a logical volume; C(decrypt) decrypts a logical volume;

options.name: device
options.description: Specifies the devices to encrypt or decrypt. For I(action=encrypt) lv/pv/vg will become encryption enabled if it is not already.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password for encryption/decryption. Used to set the intial password for encryption and provide authentication for decryption. Password must also be encrypted.
